newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rises eight cents on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rises eight cents on foreign demand.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed eight cents higher at 14.27 ringgit ($5.76) a kg after a firmer London close sparked off foreign buying, traders said.

"The market was boosted by foreign demand from Europe and Japan with buying also coming from Malaysia," a trader said, adding that the near-term trend would depend largely on consumer demand and the London's performance.
Turnover was 186 tonnes against 105 tonnes on Monday.
The local price differential to London was $55 a tonne premium compared with $80 previously.
